params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The node whose surface is displaced by a growth attribute.

params.name: attribute
params.label: Attribute
params.description: Name of the point attribute giving how far each point moves; its value times Scale is the distance. Empty leaves the geometry unchanged.

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.description: Multiplier on the attribute's value, giving the displacement in world units per unit of attribute. Negative moves points the opposite way.

params.name: direction
params.label: Direction
params.description: The vector point attribute each point moves along; its length also scales the move. N is the surface normal, worked out from the surface when the input carries no N.

params.name: group
params.label: Group
params.description: Point group to displace; other points stay put. Empty displaces every point.
